result.topic_en: A table of readings from April 23 for determining the scale value of the main spirit level (Hauptlibelle), with the readings reduced using 1'' = 1.8 mm.

methods.what: Calibration of a spirit level's scale value: angle readings are combined with bubble readings and reduced to a common bubble position (27.4 mm) using an assumed scale value of 1 arcsecond = 1.8 mm.
